Undo the last change (default), one journal entry, or every change of a session,
newest first. A 🔴 inverse (such as uninstall or rm -f) asks for confirmation like
any 🔴 command; the others run without asking again. Changes without an inverse,
or whose inverse is not confirmed, are reported and skipped. Needs `adbuddy serve` running.

Usage:
  adbuddy undo [last|session|<id>] [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy undo
  adbuddy undo j_01J9Z…
  adbuddy undo session
  adbuddy undo session --session s_01J9Y…

Flags:
  -h, --help             help for undo
      --session string   session for 'undo session' (default: the current one)

Global Flags:
      --json   machine-readable JSON output, for the commands that support it
